purpose: Human preference signals for judging retrieval changes. These are one user's picks, recorded to inform the LLM-description pilot. They are NOT expected outputs: do not gate on them, do not tune generators or embeddings against them, and do not treat disagreement as a bug.
rules: Multi-glyph combinations are a valid answer only for complex emotions or compound ideas; single glyphs stay the default.
'>' marks strict preference between tiers; entries inside a tier are similar in rank ('~').
